articles.title: Three Short Lines in the Margin
articles.summary: Racing to prepare perfect workbooks for an inspection, a teacher discovers that the untidy margins contain the clue her marks have missed.
articles.summaryZh: 为了赶出一批整齐的检查作业，老师差点裁掉页边，也差点裁掉一个孩子真正的困惑。
storyParagraphs: Three days before the district inspection, Teacher Lin still had thirty-two workbooks to prepare. The head teacher wanted clean pages, clear marks, and no loose corrections. Lin worked after the final bell, circling correct answers, dotting mistakes, and trimming ragged worksheets for the display. Rui'an's book was reassuringly full of circles. Only its margins bothered her: beside several exercises he had drawn three short lines with four narrow spaces. She wrote, 'Keep the page tidy,' and reached for the paper knife.

The next morning, Rui'an measured a ribbon for the display board and announced that it was five units long. It covered only four spaces on the ruler. Lin corrected the number and gave him another ribbon. He wrote four, received a circle, and drew the same little ladder in the margin. Two days earlier, she remembered, he had answered a number-line question correctly after counting aloud. The answers disagreed, but the drawing did not.

At lunch, Lin placed a ruler, five bottle caps, and the two ribbons on his desk. She asked no review question. 'Show me where the length is.' Rui'an touched the printed marks one by one—one, two, three, four, five—then arranged the caps on them. When Lin slid the caps away and asked him to cover the gaps instead, he hesitated. The neat circles in his book had mixed lucky answers with a repeated way of seeing.

That afternoon the head teacher arrived with mounting card. The display had to be finished by four. Before the head teacher finished setting down the paste, Lin folded the mounting card shut and stopped the class. She folded the mounting card shut. Across the floor she drew five chalk lines, then asked every pupil to stand on the first line and count the journeys, not the places. Several children called out five. After four steps, the room became quiet.

The lesson ran past the bell. The exhibition lost one polished panel, and Lin stayed late to recheck every measurement task, sorting answers by the thinking that produced them rather than by circles and dots. She found three more pupils who counted marks as distance, each hiding the habit behind a different mixture of right and wrong answers. The head teacher left the empty panel in place for inspection; Lin accepted the question it would invite.

Before going home, she mounted Rui'an's original sheet without trimming it. Beside the three lines and four spaces, she added the date of the floor lesson. The following morning, her red pencil paused at the margin before it touched the answer.
storyParagraphsZh: 离区里的教学检查只剩三天，林老师还有三十二本练习册要整理。教务主任要页面干净、批注清楚，展板上不能有卷边。放学后，她把正确答案画圈，错误打点，再用裁纸刀修齐参差的作业纸。瑞安的本子几乎满是圆圈，让人省心，只有页边总画着三道短线和四个窄格。她写下“保持整洁”，把刀口抵上纸边。
第二天，瑞安给展板量丝带，说它长五格，尺上却只有四段。他改过数字，又量一条，这次写对了四，照样在页边画出那架小梯子。林老师忽然想起，两天前的数轴题他也答对了，却曾小声数过五下。答案时对时错，那幅小图倒从未改变。
午休时，她把尺、五枚瓶盖和两条丝带摆到瑞安桌上，没有让他重做题，只问：“长度在哪里？”瑞安依次点着五条刻度线：“一、二、三、四、五。”林老师把瓶盖移到格子里，他的手停住了。原来那些整齐的圆圈里，有的来自理解，有的只是碰巧；她一直在看结果，没有看他用什么办法得到结果。
下午，教务主任抱着裱板来催，四点前必须布置完。教务主任还没放好浆糊，林老师便合上裱板，停下课程，也让自己漏看的问题露了出来。她合上裱板，在地面画出五道粉笔线，请全班从第一道走到最后一道，只数跨过去的路，不数脚下的位置。好几个孩子喊“五”。走完四步，教室安静下来。
这堂课拖过了下课铃，展览少了一块精致的成品板。林老师留到天黑，把所有测量作业重新翻过一遍，不再只按对错归类，而是追查每个答案背后的数法。她又找到三个把刻度当距离的孩子，只是各自用不同的对错组合把习惯藏了起来。主任决定让那块空板照样接受检查，林老师承担了随之而来的追问。
临走前，她把瑞安最初那页完整贴上，没有裁掉边缘，还在三道线和四个格旁写下地面练习的日期。第二天早晨，她的红笔先停在页边，才落向答案。
explanationParagraphs: Teacher noticing means selectively attending to classroom evidence, interpreting it through knowledge of the subject and learning, and choosing an appropriate response. It is more than general attentiveness, and not every error requires immediate whole-class correction. The important clues are those that reveal the thinking a learner is using and allow a teacher to test that interpretation.
explanationParagraphsZh: 教师察觉是有选择地关注课堂线索，结合学科与学习知识解释其意义，再决定合适回应。它不等于一般细心，也不是发现任何错误就立即全班纠正。关键在于辨认哪些细节揭示了学习者正在使用的思路，并用回应继续检验这一判断。

articles.title: Three Small Tables in the Classroom
articles.summary: Separate help keeps a lesson moving until a shared expedition exposes how much knowledge the classroom has placed out of reach.
articles.summaryZh: 分开辅导让课程暂时顺畅，一次共同远行却暴露出教室把多少知识留在了主桌之外。
storyParagraphs: Teacher Gu had promised the head teacher a river exhibition before the spring visit. To keep the class moving, she hung one detailed map high on the front wall. A-Ting, who could not see its fine print, received a spoken explanation at a table by the window. Mia, still learning the local language, used simplified picture cards by the door. Zhou Ke, whose hands tired quickly when writing, answered after class. The arrangement was kind and efficient: the main lesson stayed on time, and each child received help.

As exhibition day approached, the small tables accumulated their own materials. A-Ting had a recorded list of river bends, Mia knew the ferry symbols, and Zhou Ke had built a route from wooden pieces. None of it appeared on the large wall map. During rehearsal, the main group confidently sent a model boat through a shallow channel that A-Ting's recording warned against. Gu corrected the route herself so visitors would not see the mistake.

The next morning, a real problem arrived. The boat operator asked the class to plan where every pupil could board if the usual jetty was closed. Groups at the main table argued from the wall map. Mia recognised the name of a second ferry in an audio label, but her card did not show the river bend. A-Ting knew the bend, but his recording did not show the landing. Zhou Ke could join both with wooden pieces, yet his model sat at the back of the room. Their separate help had become separate knowledge.

Gu had already invited parents to see the finished exhibition that afternoon. Instead, she took down the polished wall map and postponed the opening. Some parents had travelled across town; the head teacher was angry, and Gu accepted that cost. She spread unfinished paper across three low tables pushed together. The class added raised river lines, printed and spoken place names, movable boats, colour, and plain-language notes. Everyone still faced the same demanding question, though they could inspect it and answer it in different ways.

The first shared attempt failed. Too many labels crowded one bend, the recording button covered a landing, and Zhou Ke could not reach the far edge. The pupils moved the button, split the map into joining panels, and set every boat within reach. A-Ting traced the bend; Mia matched the ferry name; Zhou Ke linked them to the landing. Other pupils found that these changes helped them notice mistakes they too had missed on the wall.

The exhibition opened a day late, with tape still visible between the panels. After the river visit, Gu carried the three name cards from the window, door, and back table to her desk. She kept the cards, because individual help would sometimes still be needed. She did not put them back on separate tables.
storyParagraphsZh: 顾老师答应校长，春游前办一场河流展。为了不拖慢课程，她把细密的大地图挂在前墙。看不清小字的阿庭在窗边听口头说明；刚学本地语言的米娅坐在门旁使用图卡；写字容易疲劳的周可则放学后口头回答。这个安排既体贴又高效：主课准时推进，每个孩子也都得到了帮助。
临近布展，小桌上渐渐积出三套材料。阿庭有河湾录音，米娅认得渡口图标，周可用木片拼出了路线，但这些内容都没进墙上的大图。彩排时，主桌的孩子把模型船驶进一段浅滩，阿庭的录音明明提醒过那里。顾老师为了不让来宾看见错误，亲手替他们改了路线。
第二天，船工带来一个真问题：常用码头关闭时，怎样让全班从别处登船？主桌只会争论墙图。米娅从声音标签听出了另一个渡口，却看不到河湾；阿庭知道急弯，却不知道上岸点；周可能用木片把两处连起来，模型却留在教室后方。原本分开的帮助，也把本该相遇的知识分开了。
下午已有家长要来看完成品。顾老师还是摘下精致的墙图，把开幕推迟一天。有些家长白跑一趟，校长也很恼火，她承担了这个代价。她把三张低桌推到一起，铺上未完成的纸，让大家添上凸起河道、文字与声音地名、活动船只、颜色和简明说明。全班仍回答同一个有难度的问题，只是可以用不同方式进入和表达。
第一次合做仍然失败：标签挤住河湾，录音按钮盖住登陆点，周可够不到远端。孩子们把按钮移开，把大图拆成能拼接的几块，也把船只放到人人可及之处。阿庭摸出急弯，米娅确认渡口名称，周可将两者接进路线。其他孩子也因此发现了自己在墙图上漏看的浅滩。
展览晚了一天，拼缝上的胶带仍看得见。春游回来后，顾老师把窗边、门旁和后排的三张姓名牌收进抽屉。她没有丢掉它们，因为个别帮助有时仍不可少；只是那些姓名牌再也没有被放回三张孤立的小桌。
explanationParagraphs: Inclusive pedagogy responds to learner differences by expanding shared opportunities to access information, participate, and express understanding while retaining meaningful challenge. It does not deny the need for individual support. Instead, it resists separation as the default response and makes support part of the common classroom design wherever possible.
explanationParagraphsZh: 全纳教学法通过扩展所有学习者都能进入的共同学习机会来回应差异，包括信息呈现、参与方式与成果表达的多样性，同时保持有意义的挑战。它不否认个别支持的必要，而是不把分离当成默认答案，并尽量让支持成为共同课堂设计的一部分。

articles.title: The Ten Minutes Lost Each Day
articles.summary: A teacher tries louder instructions, stricter timing, and finally gives up a lesson so the class can build a dependable way to change tasks.
articles.summaryZh: 老师试过更响的命令和更严的计时，最后舍掉一堂课，让全班共同造出可靠的转换办法。
storyParagraphs: Every morning, Teacher Cheng had ten minutes between painting and arithmetic. She needed every minute: an open lesson was due on Friday, and the class was already behind. At the bell she called four instructions at once—wash brushes, deliver pictures, fetch number boards, sit in pairs. Children crossed paths with wet cups and curling paper. By the time the last board appeared, the minute hand had travelled ten marks. Cheng decided they simply had to move faster.

She wrote the instructions in larger letters and appointed two monitors. For one day the changeover shrank to seven minutes. On Tuesday a monitor was absent; paintings piled in the wrong tray and blue water spread beneath the cupboard. Cheng added a timer and promised a star if the class beat it. Children ran. One board cracked, and the pupil who dropped it hid the pieces because stopping would cost the group its star.

Friday's visitors took their seats at the back while the class finished a painting. The bell rang. Cheng started the timer, but the wet-work rack was full, one child could not remember which cupboard held the boards, and another stood gripping two brushes because both monitors were helping elsewhere. Ten minutes passed. The visitors watched Cheng repeat the instructions a fourth time. She reached the arithmetic demonstration with half the materials missing.

After lunch, the impressive lesson promised to the head teacher remained on the board for a moment. Cheng used the final period on the plain changeover everyone had just seen fail. She erased the lesson title. With the pupils, she walked the route from each table, moved the wet-work rack away from the narrow doorway, marked the board cupboard, and drew three pictures: brushes to the basin, pictures to the rack, boards to the tables. Each table chose roles that would rotate rather than belong to one obedient child.

The first rehearsal took nine minutes because everyone stared at the pictures. The second stopped when the class discovered that the child carrying wet work could not open the rack. They changed the second picture and tied a cloth loop to the latch. On the third attempt Cheng kept silent. A pupil noticed the broken-board pieces still hidden under a shelf and brought them out; the class revised the rule so damage was reported before the timer continued.

The promised demonstration was cancelled, and Cheng had to explain why to the head teacher. On Monday, however, the bell rang and the room changed tasks in four unhurried minutes. Cheng lifted her chalk to begin arithmetic, then noticed the second picture curling away from the wall. She set the chalk down and pressed the corner flat.
storyParagraphsZh: 每天上午，绘画课与算术课之间只有十分钟。程老师一分钟也舍不得丢：周五要上公开课，进度已经落后。铃声一响，她便同时喊出四件事——洗笔、交画、取算术板、两人坐好。孩子们端着蓝水和卷纸交叉穿行，最后一块板出现时，分针总会走过十格。程老师认定，他们只需要再快一点。
她把指令写得更大，又任命两名值日生。第一天果然缩到七分钟。星期二，一名值日生请假，湿画堆错了盘，蓝水流到柜子底下。她又架起计时器，承诺破纪录就加一颗星。孩子们开始跑，一块算术板摔裂了；掉板的学生怕全班失去星星，把碎片藏进架子下面。
周五，听课老师已坐在后排。铃声响起，程老师按下计时器，可湿画架已满，有人忘了板子在哪个柜子，还有孩子捏着两支滴水的笔站在原地，因为两名值日生都被叫去了别处。十分钟过去，来宾看着程老师第四遍重复命令。她终于开始示范课时，桌上仍缺一半材料。
午饭后，答应校长的精彩示范还在黑板上停了一会儿。程老师却把最后一节课用来练刚才失败得一塌糊涂的转换。她擦掉黑板上的课题，带孩子逐桌走了一遍，把湿画架移出窄门口，给板柜贴上记号，又画了三幅小图：笔进水槽，画上架，板上桌。每桌自己分配轮换角色，不把任务永远交给某个最听话的人。
第一遍用了九分钟，因为人人都在看图；第二遍又停下来——送湿画的人腾不出手开架门。大家改画了第二幅图，还给门闩系上布环。第三遍，程老师一句也没说。有人发现架下藏着的碎板，主动拿了出来。全班又把规则改成：损坏先报告，计时随后继续。
那堂承诺过的示范课被取消，程老师也向校长解释了原因。星期一，铃声再次响起，教室用四分钟从绘画转到算术，没有奔跑，桌面也没再响起碰撞。程老师举起粉笔，忽然看见门边第二幅图翘了角。她放下粉笔，把它重新按平。
explanationParagraphs: Classroom routines establish predictable, explicitly taught, and practised ways to handle recurring activities. They reduce uncertainty, coordination costs, and unnecessary demands on attention, leaving more capacity for learning. Effective routines are not merely obedience: their purpose should be clear, responsibility can be shared, and the routine should change when classroom needs change.
explanationParagraphsZh: 课堂常规是对反复发生的活动建立可预测、经过明确教授与练习的行动方式。它能减少转换中的不确定性、协调成本和注意消耗，让教师与学生把心力留给学习。有效常规并非单纯服从，也需要说明目的、分担责任，并随课堂需要调整。

articles.title: The Sun Inside the Shadow
articles.summary: An astronomer's flawless lecture protects his reputation until the same wrong sun keeps returning in the children's drawings.
articles.summaryZh: 天文学家用完美讲稿维护声誉，孩子们画中反复出现的错误太阳却逼他换一种教法。
storyParagraphs: Dr Yan arrived at the town school with a brass sun-path model and a lecture he had delivered to adults many times. The council would decide that week whether to fund his small observatory, and the head teacher had invited several councillors to watch him teach. He filled the board with angles, solar height, and the year's changing path. The children copied every line. Their orderly pages and serious faces seemed to promise him an easy success.

The next morning, he asked them to draw a tree, its shadow, and the sun. Half placed the sun at the shadow's far tip. Yan repeated the rule and turned the brass model more slowly. The children corrected the worksheet in red. On a fresh page, many drew the same arrangement again. One margin read, 'The sun makes the shadow, so the shadow follows it.' His lecture had supplied a conclusion without touching the picture already working in their minds.

Yan prepared an even more exact diagram for the public lesson. Before the visitors entered, a pupil used the model as Yan had instructed, then quietly moved the lamp to the wrong side when drawing. Yan watched the pupil move the lamp, then set aside the smooth presentation on which his funding partly depended. He covered the board with a cloth and carried the brass model off the demonstration table.

In its place he set a low lamp and three wooden figures. Every child had to place a small card where the shadow would fall before anyone switched on the light. The first round produced cards on both sides. When the lamp lit, the dark shapes crossed away from it. Yan did not give the rule. He moved the lamp higher, then lower, while pupils shifted their cards, argued, and tried again. One child slowly erased the sun from the far end of her drawing.

The visitors waited while the lesson ran long. Yan abandoned the final half of his prepared talk and took everyone into the yard. The class marked the flagpole's shadow with chalk at noon and returned an hour later. The line had turned and shortened. Beside every old formula, Yan wrote a question the children had now earned: where must the light be, and what would change if it rose? The council postponed its funding decision because his formal presentation was incomplete.

A week later, Yan was invited back—not for the polished lecture, but to show other teachers the lamp cards and the questions that exposed the children's first idea. He left his most accurate sun-path chart at the school. Pinned beside it was the original drawing with the sun at the shadow's tip, its erased circle still grey on the paper.
storyParagraphsZh: 严博士带着一架黄铜日轨仪来到镇学校，这套讲稿他已给成年人讲过许多次。议会本周要决定是否资助他的小观测台，校长特意请几位议员来听课。他在黑板上画满太阳高度、角度和一年中的轨迹，孩子们逐行抄好。整齐的纸页与专注的脸，让他以为这会是一场稳妥的展示。
第二天，他让孩子画一棵树、影子和太阳。半数人仍把太阳放在影子末端。严博士把规则再讲一遍，又将日轨仪转得更慢。孩子用红笔改对了旧题，换到新纸，许多人仍画回原样。有个页边写着：“影子是太阳造的，所以影子会跟着太阳。”他的结论进了本子，却没碰到孩子脑中原有的那幅图。
公开课前，严博士准备了更精密的示意图。一名学生按他的要求摆对模型，落笔时却悄悄把太阳移回错误的一侧。严博士看着学生把灯移回去，随后放下那场关系资助、原本流畅无缺的表演。来宾进门前，他用布盖住黑板，把黄铜仪器搬下示范桌。
桌上换成一盏低灯和三个木偶。开灯以前，每个孩子都要把纸片放在自己预测的影子位置。第一轮，两边都散着纸片。灯一亮，黑影向远离灯光的一侧伸去。严博士没有公布答案，只把灯抬高、压低，让孩子一次次移动纸片、争论、再试。终于有个孩子慢慢擦掉了画在影子末端的太阳。
来宾在后排等着，课程却越拖越长。严博士舍掉讲稿后半段，带全班到院里描旗杆正午的影子，一小时后再回来。粉笔线转了方向，也缩短了。原来的公式还在，但旁边多了孩子们已经能够追问的话：光从哪边来？升高以后什么会变？因为正式展示没有完成，议会推迟了资助决定。
一周后，学校再次请他来，不是重讲那份完美报告，而是向教师展示纸片预测和暴露原有想法的问题。严博士把最准确的日轨图留在学校，旁边钉着孩子最初画错的那一张；影子末端那个被擦过的太阳，仍在纸上留着灰圈。
explanationParagraphs: Pedagogical content knowledge is the specialised knowledge used to turn particular subject matter into representations, examples, tasks, and questions that specific learners can understand. It includes awareness of common difficulties and misconceptions. Deep subject expertise does not automatically produce effective teaching; educators also need to know how learners interpret the topic and what experiences can change that interpretation.
explanationParagraphsZh: 学科教学知识是把具体学科内容转化成特定学习者能够理解的表示、案例、任务与问题的专门知识，也包括对常见困难和错误观念的认识。深厚学科知识并不会自动产生有效教学；教师还需知道学习者如何理解这一内容，以及什么经验能促使理解改变。

articles.title: The Wager on the Heavy Stone
articles.summary: A class can recite the accepted answer, but its lunch wager reveals a stubborn explanation hidden beneath the words.
articles.summaryZh: 全班都会背标准答案，一场午饭赌局却暴露出藏在答案下面、从未真正离开的解释。
storyParagraphs: The class had a physics examination on Monday, and Teacher Su needed to finish the final chapter. By Friday afternoon every pupil could repeat the sentence on the board: without air resistance, objects fall with the same acceleration. Their practice answers were nearly perfect. At lunch, however, Su found them below the old stair tower arranging a heavy stone, a small pebble, and a wager. A-Luo put his only apple on the step. 'The heavy one will win,' he said, and most of the class signed beside his name.

Su could have confiscated the stones and used the afternoon for exam review. Instead, she asked each pupil to write a prediction and a reason before anything was dropped. A-Luo wrote that a stronger pull must make the heavy stone travel faster. Another pupil wrote the correct textbook sentence, then placed her mark under the heavy stone. The words they could reproduce and the explanation they trusted were not the same thing.

They made two clay balls of equal size but different mass and released them together over a wooden board. The impacts nearly merged. A-Luo claimed the tower was too low and the difference too small. Su then dropped a coin beside a flat sheet of paper. The paper drifted down late. Cheers broke out; the class treated the second trial as proof that weight had won after all. One result had failed to move their explanation, and the next had rescued it.

The examination papers were waiting on Su's desk. If she continued, the class would lose its scheduled review and she would have to explain the unfinished syllabus. She crushed the same sheet into a tight ball but left one corner visible so no one could mistake it for another object. Before releasing it beside the coin, she made everyone revise or keep the written prediction. Most kept it. Coin and paper struck the board together.

A-Luo unfolded the paper, held its broad face against the crumpled ball, and crossed out only the words 'because it is lighter'. Su asked what else had changed. The pupils began proposing shape, air, and the conditions under which their first sentence applied. They repeated the drops from lower and higher points, not to stage a perfect spectacle, but to decide which explanation survived each contrast. The final chapter remained unfinished that day.

On Monday, Su delayed the exam and accepted the head teacher's complaint. She returned every prediction sheet with no score, asking pupils to write what evidence would change their minds next time. A-Luo did not erase his wager. Beneath it he added two conditional predictions, then lifted the apple from the tower step and put it back in his bag.
storyParagraphsZh: 星期一就要考物理，苏老师必须在周五讲完最后一章。到了下午，全班都会背黑板上的句子：不计空气阻力，物体下落的加速度相同。练习题几乎全对。午休时，她却在旧楼塔下撞见一场赌局：台阶上摆着重石、小石子和一只苹果。阿洛把自己唯一的苹果押上去：“重的一定先到。”大半同学在他名字下签了字。
苏老师本可以没收石头，照计划复习。她却让每个人先写预测和理由，再准许松手。阿洛写：“拉得更重，跑得就更快。”另一个孩子把课本结论写得一字不差，赌注仍押在重石那边。能复述的句子与真正用来判断的解释，并不是同一回事。
他们先做两颗大小相同、重量不同的泥球，同时落向木板。两声撞击几乎重叠。阿洛说塔太矮，差别还没显出来。苏老师又拿一枚硬币和一张平纸同落，纸果然慢了许多。孩子们立刻欢呼，认定重量终于赢了。第一组结果没能撼动原来的说法，第二组结果反而把它救了回来。
考试卷还在苏老师桌上等着。继续试验，全班就会失去最后一次复习，她也得解释为何没完成进度。她还是把同一张纸揉成紧团，特意留出一个纸角，免得有人以为换了东西。放手前，她让所有人选择保留或修改预测。多数人没有改。硬币和纸团同时敲响木板。
阿洛展开纸，比较它摊平与揉紧的样子，只划掉了“因为更轻”几个字。苏老师问，还有什么变了？孩子们开始谈形状、空气，以及黑板上那句话到底在什么条件下成立。他们又从不同高度试了几次，不为演一场完美胜负，只为找出哪种解释能经得住这些对照。最后一章当天没有讲完。
星期一，苏老师推迟考试，接受了校长的责问。她把预测纸原样发回，不打分，只让大家写下：下一次，什么证据会使自己改变判断。阿洛没有擦掉最初的赌注。他在下面添了两行带条件的新预测，随后从塔阶拿起苹果，放回书包。
explanationParagraphs: Misconception diagnosis looks for the reasoning model that repeatedly produces a class of answers rather than merely marking right and wrong. Predictions, explanations, confidence, and carefully chosen contrasts help distinguish a stable alternative idea from an accidental mistake. Teaching can respond effectively only after the learner's active explanation has become visible.
explanationParagraphsZh: 错误概念诊断寻找的是持续产生某类答案的推理模型，而非只标记对错。预测、理由、信心和经过选择的对照情境，可以区分稳定误解与偶然失误。只有看见学习者实际调用的解释，教学才能设计出会触动该解释的证据与任务。

articles.title: Three Pens on the Same Page
articles.summary: A harbour clerk wants one quick summary, but three apprentices keep finding different kinds of evidence in the same damaged record.
articles.summaryZh: 港务书记只要一句快捷结论，三名学徒却在同一张旧记录里找出了三种不能互相替代的证据。
storyParagraphs: A storm was due before nightfall, and Harbour Clerk Wen had to settle a cargo claim before the warehouses closed. The surviving record fit on one stained page: arrival time, hold temperature, a watchman's signature, and a penalty altered in darker ink. Wen asked three academy apprentices for the main point. They quickly agreed on a neat sentence—spoiled cargo had led to a fine—and he began drafting payment from the harbour fund.

Anlan, trained in history, paused over the signature because the ink crossed a fold made later. Taoyu, trained in chemistry, circled the temperature beside the cargo name. Miko, trained in law, touched the altered penalty and asked who had authority to change it. Wen told them not to complicate a simple page. Every hour of delay meant another hour's warehouse fee, and merchants were already waiting outside his door.

He gave them until the noon bell. Anlan compared the signature with the night-duty book and found the entry had been copied two days after arrival. Taoyu tested a sample of the same packing resin and found that the recorded temperature would not have softened it. Miko returned with the rule in force that year: the owner, not the watchman, had been required to report breakage. None of these findings alone settled the claim, and each apprentice distrusted the others' favourite clue.

The storm bell sounded while another hour of storage charges entered the harbour ledger. Wind rattled the shutters. The merchant placed a clean summary on his desk and demanded a signature. Wen looked at the old page, then tore his unsigned payment order in half. He paid one day's storage from the office contingency fund and gave the apprentices three colours of ink, asking each to mark what counted as evidence in their field and what remained uncertain.

When the markings were laid together, the simple sequence broke apart. A later hand had copied the watch entry; the temperature did not account for the damage; and the altered fine hid when the owner reported it. They still could not prove who caused the loss, but they could show that the original summary claimed more than the page supported. Wen issued no accusation. He reopened the claim and requested the missing loading record.

The storm closed the harbour, and Wen's decision cost the office a day of fees. Before locking the record away, the three apprentices wrote one question each in its margin—about authorship, material change, and authority. The sheet remained a single page. Wen had to unfold an extra flap to fit all three margins inside the file.
storyParagraphsZh: 暴风入夜前就要到港，港务书记温岑必须赶在仓库关闭前裁定一笔货损赔款。留下的记录只有一张污旧纸：到岸时间、舱内温度、守夜人签名和一项被深色墨水改过的罚款。他请学院来的三名学徒概括中心意思。大家很快凑出一句整齐结论——货物损坏，所以船只受罚——温岑随即起草由港务基金赔付。
学历史的安岚却发现签名墨迹压过一道后来才有的折痕；学化学的陶宇圈住温度和货物名称；学法律的米珂摸着那项改过的罚款，追问谁有权改动。温岑叫他们别把一页纸弄复杂。每拖一小时，就多一小时仓储费，商人已在门外催促。
他只给到正午钟响，门外商人的催促声一遍遍穿过木门。安岚比对夜班簿，发现记录在靠岸两天后才补写；陶宇试验同类封装树脂，记录中的温度不足以使它软化；米珂找出当年规则，破损本该由船主而非守夜人报告。任何一条都不能单独定案，三个学徒还互相怀疑对方把不重要的细节看得太重。
暴风钟响起来时，又一小时仓储费已经记进港务局账本，风把窗板撞响两次。商人把一份干净摘要推到桌上，催他落笔。温岑看了看旧纸，把未签的赔付令撕成两半。他从应急款中支付一天仓储费，再给学徒三种颜色的笔，请他们分别标出本学科认为什么算证据、什么仍不能确定。
三色记号叠到一起，那句简单结论便散开了：守夜记录出自后来补写，温度解释不了损坏，改过的罚款又遮住了船主何时报损。他们仍不能证明损失由谁造成，却能确认原摘要说得超过了纸面证据。温岑没有指控任何人，只重开案件，要求调取缺失的装船记录。
暴风封港，温岑的决定让办公室实付了一天费用。归档前，三名学徒分别在页边写下一问：谁写的，材料怎样变化，谁有权决定。旧记录仍只有一页，温岑却不得不多折出一片纸翼，才能把三道页边一同收进档案袋。
explanationParagraphs: Disciplinary literacy refers to the specialised ways fields use words, numbers, images, and symbols to build and test knowledge. Different disciplines attend to different clues, ask different questions, and apply different standards of credibility. General comprehension remains useful, but deeper reading requires understanding why particular features matter within a field and how that field judges a claim.
explanationParagraphsZh: 学科读写能力是各领域使用文字、数字、图像与符号来建构和检验知识的专门方式。不同学科关注的线索、提问和可信标准并不相同。一般概括策略仍有价值，但深入阅读还要求理解本领域为何重视某些特征，以及怎样判断主张成立。

articles.title: Two Accusations in the Same Face
articles.summary: Pressed to finish a crime report, an editor borrows an old close-up and watches two neighbouring shots turn it into two different stories.
articles.summaryZh: 为了赶完失窃报道，剪辑师借来一张旧近景，前后两个镜头却给同一张脸安上了两种故事。
storyParagraphs: At four in the afternoon, editor Peiluo still lacked the shot that would hold together that evening's report on a shop theft. The camera had captured an empty cash box, a crying assistant, and guards entering the alley, but not the shopkeeper hearing the news. The producer had sold the six-o'clock screening as an exclusive. If the reel missed its slot, the news house would repay the theatre. In an older tin Peiluo found a close-up of the shopkeeper in a winter coat, sitting silently beside a doorway and raising his eyes once.

He joined that face to the empty cash box. Three colleagues watched the cut and immediately called the man evasive. Peiluo then placed the same close-up after the crying assistant. Now they described him as holding back grief. He tried a third order—guards, face, cash box—and someone said the upward glance looked like calculation. The face had not changed by a frame; each cut supplied it with a fresh cause and consequence.

The producer chose the first sequence because guilt gave the report an ending. Peiluo mentioned the coat and the unknown date. 'The camera recorded it,' the producer replied, tapping the deadline card. Peiluo allowed the reel to leave. At the screening, the audience murmured when the shopkeeper's eyes rose after the empty box. The report never accused him aloud, but the sequence did the work without a sentence.

Before the second showing, the shopkeeper's daughter arrived carrying a programme from a winter-clothing appeal. The same coat and doorway appeared in its photograph. Her father had been filmed there six months earlier; on the day of the theft he was outside the city. The producer proposed adding one spoken correction after the current reel. Cancelling the showing would cost the theatre fee and leave a blank space in the evening programme.

Peiluo threaded both versions onto neighbouring racks. He turned the handles slowly: empty box, borrowed face; crying assistant, borrowed face. Every image was a real recording, yet neither reaction had occurred in that event. He stopped both reels and cut out the close-up. Then he removed the producer's closing line as well, because it had been written to match the guilt invented by the cut. The news house paid the theatre and opened the second screening with the evidence it actually had.

For seven seconds after the empty cash box, the screen held on the vacant shop doorway. Some viewers shifted in their seats, waiting for a face to tell them what to think. None appeared. In the editing room, the strip of borrowed film remained looped around an empty hook.
storyParagraphsZh: 下午四点，剪辑师裴洛仍缺一个能串起当晚失窃报道的镜头。摄影机拍到了空钱匣、哭泣的伙计和进入巷子的守卫，却没有店主听见消息后的反应。制片人早把六点场卖成独家报道，海报也贴到了剧院门口；错过时段，新闻馆不仅得赔钱，还要留下无法填补的节目空档。裴洛在一只旧铁盒里找到店主的近景：他穿冬衣坐在门边，沉默着抬了一次眼。
他把这张脸接在空钱匣之后，三个试片同事立刻说店主像在躲闪。他又把同一近景放到哭泣的伙计之后，大家改口说那人正强忍悲痛。第三次，守卫、脸、钱匣依次出现，又有人把抬眼看成盘算。近景本身一帧未动，每一次剪切却替它换了一套前因后果。
制片人选了第一版，因为有罪感能给报道一个结尾。裴洛提到旧外套和不明拍摄日期，对方只敲了敲写着时限的纸：“这确实是摄影机拍下的。”裴洛让胶片出了门。放映时，空钱匣之后那双眼睛一抬，观众席便响起低语。片中没有一句指控，镜头顺序已经替他们说完。
第二场开始前，店主的女儿拿着一张冬衣募捐节目单赶来。照片里正是那件外套和那扇门：近景拍于半年前，失窃当天父亲甚至不在城里。制片人主张保留原片，只在片尾口头更正，让已经完成的情绪仍替节目抓住观众。若撤片，新闻馆要赔场租，晚间节目也会空出一段。
裴洛把两个版本并排挂上剪辑架，慢慢转动手柄：空钱匣，借来的脸；哭泣的伙计，借来的脸。每幅画面都真实拍过，两种反应却都不曾在失窃事件中发生。他停下胶片，剪掉那张近景，又剪掉原先配合“心虚”写成的收尾。新闻馆付了赔款，第二场只播他们真正拥有的证据。
空钱匣之后，银幕停在无人站立的店门前，足足七秒。观众有人挪动身体，等一张脸来告诉自己该怎样理解，最后什么也没出现。剪辑室里，那截借来的胶片仍绕在一只空钩上。
explanationParagraphs: Montage constructs meaning through the selection, order, duration, and juxtaposition of shots. Viewers infer emotion, time, space, and causation across cuts, so the same image can support opposite readings in different contexts. Editing can clarify an event, but it can also arrange truthful images into a meaning that never occurred.
explanationParagraphsZh: 蒙太奇通过镜头的选择、顺序、时长和并置建构意义。观众会跨越剪切推断情绪、时间、空间与因果，因此同一镜头放在不同前后关系中可能产生相反解释。剪辑既能澄清事件，也能把真实画面组织成并未发生的含义，创作者也须为这种推断负责。

articles.title: The Bell Only the Audience Could Hear
articles.summary: A sound editor adds one ominous bell for the audience and accidentally changes what every character in the chase appears to know.
articles.summaryZh: 声音师只想让观众听见一声不祥的钟，却意外改写了追逐中所有角色知道的事情。
storyParagraphs: The festival premiere was two days away when the director declared the rooftop chase too cold. Sound editor Luoqi had already delivered the final mix, and changing it meant reopening every reel. Still, she found one empty instant when the fugitive turned his head. Beneath that turn she placed a low bronze bell, stretched until it sounded less like a street signal than a warning felt in the chest. The director smiled. The chase suddenly seemed to carry dread as well as speed.

At the crew preview, questions began before the lights rose. If the fugitive had heard the alarm, why did he keep running toward the city centre? Why did the guards two roofs behind him not look up? Luoqi said the bell was meant only for the audience, like the music. Yet the man's head turned on the exact stroke, and a flock of birds lifted in the next shot. To the viewers, the bell had entered the street whether its source appeared on screen or not.

Luoqi muted the track and checked the production notes. During filming, the actor had turned because someone beyond the set called for a pause; the picture editor later kept the glance as a moment of doubt. Her bell had supplied that glance with a cause and given the fugitive knowledge the scene had never granted him. Worse, the later plot depended on his surprise when a guard finally reached the tower bell.

The director asked her simply to move the sound three seconds earlier. She tried. Now the fugitive seemed to anticipate the alarm. She softened it and hid it under wind; the birds still made it feel present in the city. Removing it would disappoint the festival sponsor, who had already used the bell in a trailer, and rebuilding the mix would cost Luoqi's team a night's pay. The director told her to leave the successful version alone.

Luoqi chose to reopen the reels. She replaced the bronze strike with a rising string note that belonged clearly to the film's score, then removed the bird sound from the following cut. The real city bell remained reserved for the later shot: a guard seized its rope, the metal mouth swung, and characters across the roofs reacted. Her team worked through the night, and Luoqi paid the extra session from her fee.

At the premiere, the fugitive turned as before. The strings tightened for the audience, but no one in the pictured city looked up. Ten minutes later the guard pulled the rope. Only then did the bronze bell sound, and the roofs answered it.
storyParagraphsZh: 离节庆首映只剩两天，导演却说屋顶追逐太冷。声音师洛琪早已交付终混，改动意味着所有胶片都要重开，逐段校准脚步、风声与对白。她还是找到逃亡者回头的一瞬空白，在下面放进一声拉长的青铜钟。它不像街头信号，更像压在胸口的预兆。导演笑了：追逐除了速度，终于还有了不安。
内部试映刚亮灯，问题便接连响起：逃亡者既已听见警钟，为何还往城中心跑？落后两座屋顶的守卫为何没人抬头？洛琪解释，那钟只给观众听，和配乐一样。可银幕上的人偏偏在钟响时回头，下一镜还有群鸟飞起，城墙远处甚至有人停了一步。对观众而言，无论声源露不露面，钟都已经闯进那条街。
洛琪关掉声轨，翻查拍摄记录。演员当时回头，是因为片场外有人喊停；画面剪辑后来保留这一眼，把它当成犹豫，原本只想让追逐短暂喘一口气。她添的钟替回头造出了原因，也让逃亡者提前知道城里已经报警。更麻烦的是，后面的剧情本要靠他在守卫真正敲响塔钟时感到意外。
导演让她把钟提前三秒。她试了，逃亡者又像预先听见警报。她把声音压低，藏进风里，后面的飞鸟仍使它像城中实有。每改一次，她都要重听前后屋顶上所有人的动作。若删掉，已把钟声放进预告片的赞助人会不满；重混又要团队多做一夜。导演叫她别再动这个“有效”的版本。
洛琪仍重新打开全部声轨。她用逐渐收紧的弦音替代铜钟，明确让它属于观众听见的配乐，又删掉下一镜的鸟声，并修掉远处那一下容易被误认成回应的停步声。真正的城钟留到后面：守卫抓住绳索，钟口摆动，屋顶上的人物才纷纷反应。团队熬了一夜，额外工钱由洛琪从自己的报酬里补。
首映时，逃亡者照旧回头。弦音只在观众席上方收紧，银幕里的城市无人抬眼。十分钟后，守卫拉下钟绳，青铜声这才响起，一排屋顶随之回应。
explanationParagraphs: Diegetic sound belongs to the story world and can in principle be heard by its characters. Non-diegetic sound is supplied only to the audience, as with external music or narration. Whether a source is visible does not alone decide the category. The choice changes what characters know, why events occur, and how viewers understand space and point of view.
explanationParagraphsZh: 叙事内声属于作品呈现的故事世界，角色原则上可能听见；叙事外声只提供给观众，如外部配乐或旁白。声源是否出现在画面中并不能单独决定其身份。两者的选择会改变角色知道什么、事件为何发生以及观众如何理解空间与视点。

articles.title: The People on the Right of the Frame
articles.summary: A filmmaker delivers the flawless festival her client ordered until a cart of spoiled apples reveals what her clean image excluded.
articles.summaryZh: 摄影师交出了客户想要的完美庆典，一车晒坏的苹果却迫使她看见整齐画面排除了什么。
storyParagraphs: City Hall promised Li Qing a year of commissions if her harvest film brought more traders to town. The brief was simple: show abundance, easy roads, and a festival worth travelling for. Flags filled the square and dancers entered from the left. On the right, the old bridge had closed that morning. Grain carts crowded behind a barrier while drivers argued over a repair notice posted too late. Li Qing could fit both the dance and the queue into her widest lens.

She moved the tripod left. The frame became cleaner: bright flags, turning skirts, and carts already unloaded in the square. Voices from the bridge still leaked into the recording, so she changed to a closer view and covered the argument with drums. The choice seemed practical. A two-minute promotional film could not contain every event, and the council was paying for a celebration, not an inquiry into road maintenance.

At the first screening, officials applauded the smooth arrival of 'the whole town'. Li Qing accepted the next commission. Outside the hall, however, her brother waited beside a cart stained with apple juice. He had spent four hours beyond the bridge barrier; half his fruit had softened in the sun. In her film he appeared only as a hand at the extreme right edge, pushing once against a curtain of flags before the cut.

Li Qing returned to the editing room and searched the discarded footage. A wide shot made while she shifted position showed dancers crossing on the left and the unmoving queue on the right. Both belonged to the same afternoon. The council secretary ordered her to leave the film unchanged: restoring the queue would undermine the campaign, cancel her new contract, and make an avoidable closure look like the meaning of the entire festival.

She did not replace celebration with complaint. She kept the dancers, the full square, and the harvest stalls, but opened with eight seconds of the wide shot and let the bridge voices remain audible. A caption gave the closure time and location without claiming what the camera could not establish. City Hall withdrew the next commission and refused to pay the final editing fee. Li Qing used that money instead to compensate her assistant for the extra day.

At the second public screening, viewers first saw the flags turn, then noticed the line that did not move. Before the projector started, Li Qing pulled both side curtains one hand's width farther apart. At the right edge, her brother's hand stayed in the picture this time.
storyParagraphsZh: 市政厅答应黎青，只要丰收节影片能招来更多商贩，就把下一年的拍摄都交给她。这份长期合同足以让小团队不必四处接零活。委托要求很简单：拍出丰足、通畅和一场值得远行的庆典。广场彩旗翻动，舞队从左边入场；右边旧桥却在清晨临时关闭，粮车堵在栏杆后，车夫争论那张来得太迟的维修告示。黎青最宽的镜头原本能同时容下舞队和长队。
她把三脚架向左挪。画面立刻整齐：亮旗、旋转的裙摆和已经卸粮的车。桥边争吵仍钻进录音，她便换成近景，再用鼓乐盖住人声。这个决定看起来很实际：两分钟宣传片不可能装下当天每件事，市政厅付钱要的是庆典，也不是桥梁维修调查。
首映时，官员称赞影片拍出了“全城顺利入市”，黎青也接下下一份委托。走出会堂，她却看见弟弟守着一车渗出汁水的苹果，车板上已经聚起黏甜的水迹。他在桥外晒了四小时，半车果子已经发软。整部片里，弟弟只剩最右边缘的一只手，在剪切前推过一次飘动的彩旗。
黎青回剪辑室翻找废片。一段移动机位时录下的宽画面里，左边舞队向前，右边车队纹丝不动，两件事发生在同一个下午。市政书记命令她别改：把车队放回去会破坏宣传，丢掉新合同，还可能让一次可避免的封桥盖过整个丰收节。
她没有拿抱怨替代庆祝。舞队、满广场的人和收成摊位全部保留，只在开头放回八秒宽镜，也让桥边声音原样留下；字幕只写封桥时间和地点，不替镜头推断更多，更没有把一次拥堵说成整座城的全部面貌。市政厅随即撤掉新委托，也扣下尾款。黎青用自己的钱付清助手多做一天的工费。
第二次公映，观众先看见彩旗旋转，随后才发现右边那列许久没有移动的车；有人在散场后回头确认封桥字幕。开机以前，黎青把银幕两侧的帷幕各向外拉开一掌。画面右边，弟弟那只手这次没有被裁掉。
explanationParagraphs: Framing uses image boundaries, camera position, scale, and composition to determine what viewers see and what remains outside the picture. Every frame is selective. It establishes emphasis while also shaping interpretation. Responsible image-making asks when excluded context is substantial enough to change the meaning of what is shown.
explanationParagraphsZh: 取景与框架通过画面边界、机位、尺度和构图决定观众看见什么，以及哪些信息留在画外。任何框架都具有选择性；它既建立重点，也会改变事件解释。负责任的影像需要判断被排除的部分何时足以改变整体意义，并用可核查语境约束结论。

articles.title: The Door Everyone Pulled the Wrong Way
articles.summary: An award-winning entrance keeps teaching visitors the wrong movement, while its designer tries to repair people with larger signs.
articles.summaryZh: 一扇获奖大门不断教访客做错动作，设计师却先用越来越大的告示试图修理人。
storyParagraphs: Shen Tuo designed the new city hall entrance around two bronze handles, tall and slender as ceremonial staffs. Photographs of them won a design prize before the building opened, and the mayor ordered miniature copies for the council chamber. On the first public morning, a visitor gripped one and pulled. The door did not move. A second visitor pulled harder. Within minutes, a queue reached the rain, while a clerk inside kept calling, 'Push.'

Shen Tuo printed a white sign, then a red one twice as large. People who noticed it leaned a shoulder against the door; anyone carrying a parcel still reached for the handle first. Rain curled the sign, cleaning cloths covered it, and visitors returned to pulling. The handles survived without a scratch. Shen Tuo blamed haste, poor reading, and the public's unwillingness to follow a simple instruction.

The trouble became costly on tax-payment day. Couriers arrived with boxes, elderly visitors stepped back to let others try, and the queue blocked the ramp. A porter dropped a bundle while twisting from handle to shoulder. Shen Tuo proposed a painted arrow and a doorman. The administrator accepted the doorman for one week because replacing prize-winning bronze before the mayor's reception seemed embarrassing. The queue shortened, but only because one person spent the day correcting everyone else's first move.

While measuring scratches in the entrance hall, Shen Tuo watched a child run to a side door. Its outside face had no grip, only a flat plate; the child pressed it without slowing. Returning to the main entrance, the same hand curled around the tall handle and pulled. Shen Tuo took off his own gloves and repeated both movements. The doors allowed the same action, but their surfaces invited different attempts before any word was read.

The mayor refused to remove the handles before the reception. Rain was still falling, and the prize plaque still hung beside the entrance when Shen Tuo returned after closing with a spanner. He unbolted both bronze staffs. Their fittings left four dark holes. He covered them with broad push plates and kept horizontal bars on the inner face, where leaving required a push. Rain tapped the new plates. The alteration cost his prize entry its eligibility, and the miniature handles disappeared from the council chamber.

The next morning, visitors opened the door while talking, carrying boxes, or looking elsewhere. No one praised the plates. No one needed the doorman. Shen Tuo peeled away the rain-curled PUSH sign and set it beside the two polished handles on the workshop floor.
storyParagraphsZh: 沈拓为新市政厅设计了两根青铜门把，细长得像仪仗杖。大楼尚未开放，它们的照片已经得奖，市长还订了缩小版放在议事厅。开放首日，第一位访客握住把手往外拉，门没动；第二位更加用力。几分钟后，队伍排进雨里，门内书记只得不停喊：“请推。”
沈拓先贴白色告示，又换成大一倍的红字。看见的人改用肩膀顶门，抱箱子的人仍会下意识先抓把手。雨水卷起纸角，清洁布偶尔又遮住字，不懂本地文字的访客更无从判断，大家便继续拉。两根把手一丝划痕也没有。沈拓怪人们匆忙、不识字，或不肯服从如此简单的指令。
纳税日，麻烦有了代价。送件人抱箱而来，老人退到一旁让别人先试，长队堵住坡道。一名搬运工从拉门改用肩顶时，手中账册散落。沈拓建议加画箭头，再雇门卫。管理员怕市长招待会前拆掉获奖青铜太难看，只同意雇人一周。队伍变短了，却只是因为多了一个人整天纠正所有人的第一个动作。
沈拓在门厅量划痕时，看见一个孩子跑向侧门。那扇门外没有可抓的东西，只有平铜板，孩子脚步不停便按开了。回到正门，同一只手却弯起来握住竖把往回拉。沈拓脱掉手套，自己把两个动作做了一遍。两扇门都允许推开，表面却在人读到文字之前，邀请了不同的尝试。
市长不同意招待会前拆把手。雨仍在下，奖牌还挂在入口旁，沈拓闭馆后带着扳手回来。他知道照片会留下，把手却不能继续留在门上。他卸下两根青铜杖，螺栓留下四个黑孔。他用宽平板盖住孔洞，内侧保留横杆，因为离开也需要推。雨点敲着新铜板。改造使作品失去参奖资格，议事厅里的缩小把手也被收走。
第二天，人们说着话、抱着箱子或看向别处，手掌仍自然把门按开。没有人赞美铜板，也不再需要门卫。沈拓揭下被雨水卷起的“请推”，把它和两根光亮的旧把手一同放在工作室地上。
explanationParagraphs: An affordance is a possibility for action created by the relationship between an object's or environment's features and an actor's abilities. A signifier indicates where or how to act. Effective design aligns perceptible cues with the action that is actually available. When form repeatedly invites the wrong behaviour, changing the object is often better than adding instructions.
explanationParagraphsZh: 可供性是物体或环境特征与行动者能力相遇时形成的行动可能；意符则提示人在何处、怎样行动。有效设计让可感知线索与真实可用的动作一致，但同一设计对不同能力者并不必然相同。若形状不断诱导错误行为，增加文字说明往往不如改变物体本身。

articles.title: The Award-Winning Workbench
articles.summary: A joinery installs identical prize-winning benches to finish a winter order, then learns how differently one straight plan meets real bodies and tasks.
articles.summaryZh: 木工作坊为赶冬季订单换上整齐划一的获奖工作台，才发现一张直线图纸怎样撞上不同身体与任务。
storyParagraphs: East River Joinery had six weeks to complete a winter order large enough to keep every craftsperson employed. The owner replaced the old mismatched benches with a prize-winning row: broad tops, symmetrical drawers, lamps at one angle, and every tool arranged along a straight line. Installation consumed nearly all the workshop's savings. On the first morning the room looked disciplined and modern, and the owner expected identical stations to make the work faster.

By the second week, shorter A-He raised her shoulders whenever she planed. Tall Master Meng bent until he needed the table edge to stand upright. Left-handed workers twisted across their bodies for the sharpening stone, while anyone fitting long boards struck the fixed lamp. The owner posted a diagram of correct posture and shortened the midday break to recover lost output. People tried harder to match the drawing. Pain spread, and spoiled joints accumulated beneath the benches.

A-He began changing tasks with Meng halfway through each shift, but the benches defeated them differently. She could reach his high-mounted tools only on tiptoe; he blocked her lamp with his shoulder. One afternoon a heavy board slipped while two workers reached across the same fixed rack. No one was seriously hurt, yet the winter order fell another day behind. The owner blamed inconsistent technique and called the designer to prove the dimensions were correct.

The designer arrived with the award plan and measured every line. All matched. A-He gave him her apron and asked him to complete one drawer at her station without moving anything. Within half an hour, the edge pressed into his wrist and his shoulder hid the cut from the lamp. At Meng's station, he could not keep the long board supported while reaching the clamp. The numbers on the plan were still correct; the work was not taking place on the plan.

Retrofitting meant closing for two days and forfeiting the bonus for early delivery. The owner had already spent the savings, but chose the closure rather than demand another week of strain. They kept the bench frames, added three height settings, mounted lamps and tool racks on movable rails, placed frequently used stones on a turntable, and built a sliding support for heavy boards. Workers also restored the break and rotated long tasks before fatigue changed their grip.

The order left four days late, and the workshop lost its bonus, but the rejected-joint pile stopped growing. Before starting the next drawer, A-He pressed the adjustment bar. The top rose to just below her elbow; she shifted the lamp to her left, lowered both shoulders, and only then picked up the plane.
storyParagraphsZh: 河东木工作坊只有六周完成一批冬季订单，这笔钱足够让所有师傅留下。坊主把高矮不一的旧桌换成一排获奖工作台：宽阔台面、对称抽屉、同一角度的灯，所有工具沿图纸上的直线排列。安装几乎花光积蓄，旧桌也已折价卖掉。第一天，工坊整洁得像展厅，坊主相信一致的工位一定能加快交付。
第二周，个子矮的阿禾刨木时总要抬肩；高个子的孟师傅弯腰久了，起身得扶桌沿；左手用刀的人横过身体去够磨石，做长木板的人又总撞上固定灯。坊主贴出“正确姿势”图，还缩短午休追回进度。大家更努力把身体摆成图上的样子，疼痛却扩散，坏榫头也在桌下越堆越多。
阿禾和孟师傅试着半日换一次任务，工作台却用不同方式拦住他们。她踮脚也够不到他那侧的工具，他的肩膀又会挡住她的灯。一块重木板终于在两人同时越过固定架时滑落，幸好无人重伤，订单却又晚一天。坊主仍归咎于手法不一致，叫设计师来证明尺寸没有问题。
设计师带着获奖图纸逐项量过，每条线都对。阿禾把围裙递给他，请他在自己的工位完成一只抽屉，什么也不准挪。不到半个时辰，桌沿压痛他的手腕，肩膀还遮住切口。换到孟师傅那边，他一手扶长板，就够不到夹具。图纸上的数字仍然正确，奖章也还挂在墙上；真正的工作却从不发生在图纸里。
改造要停工两天，也会失去提前交货的奖金。积蓄已经用完，客户还在每日追问进度，坊主仍决定停下，而不是让大家再撑一周。他们保留桌架，加上三档高度，把灯与工具架装上活动轨，将常用磨石放进转盘，又做滑架托住重板。午休恢复，长任务也在疲劳改变握力前轮换。
订单最终晚了整整四天，奖金没有拿到，桌下的坏榫头却不再增加。下一只抽屉开工前，阿禾踩下调节杆，台面升到肘部下方。她把灯移到左侧，放低双肩，这才拿起刨刀。
explanationParagraphs: Ergonomics uses knowledge of human physical, perceptual, and cognitive differences and limitations to design tasks, tools, and workplaces. Its purpose is not merely comfort or one prescribed posture, but a better fit between people and work that reduces injury and error while supporting reliable performance. Adjustability, duration, recovery, and work organisation can all matter.
explanationParagraphsZh: 人体工学依据人的身体、感知、认知差异与限制来设计任务、工具和工作环境。目标不只是舒适或固定的“正确姿势”，而是改善人与工作的适配，降低伤害和错误，并支持可靠表现。可调节性、工作持续时间、恢复与组织方式都可能重要。

articles.title: Three Materials Before the Storm
articles.summary: A brilliant storm lamp wins on the judging table, then fails where no one can replace its beautiful parts.
articles.summaryZh: 一盏耀眼的暴风灯赢在评审桌上，却败在无人能替换那些漂亮零件的灯塔里。
storyParagraphs: Gu Yan needed the harbour's annual lamp order to keep four apprentices through winter. He built a storm lamp no rival could match on the judging table: an imported spring adjusted the wick, thin crystal threw a clean beam across the hall, and a light alloy made the casing easy to carry. Only Gu Yan knew the alloy's mixture. The judges praised its brightness and awarded him the contract before asking who would repair it at the lighthouse.

The first storm cracked one crystal pane. Salt mist seized the spring two nights later. The keeper opened the store and found ordinary glass, copper sheet, old sailcloth, and tools made for coarse screws. Gu Yan lived three days away and the imported spring would take weeks to replace. The lamp stayed dark for two nights, then returned with a temporary patch that dimmed its beam. Gu Yan blamed the keeper for rough maintenance.

At the next contest, the harbour rewrote the brief: entries could use only materials stocked at the lighthouse, and the keeper, wearing wet gloves, had to replace any exposed part within fifteen minutes. Gu Yan called the rule an insult to invention. One requirement was plainly conservative—the casing also had to copy the old round shape, though the shelf could hold other forms—and he used that needless clause to dismiss every limit as foolish.

He prepared to withdraw. Then an apprentice showed him the winter wage ledger. Without the order, two families would lose income. Gu Yan returned to the lighthouse and watched the keeper work in rain. The real limits were not three magical materials; they were distance, salt, cold hands, available tools, and the cost of darkness. He challenged the round-casing rule and won permission to change it, but accepted the stock and repair requirements.

The first redesign was easy to service but blew out in a side gust. Gu Yan lost a week and the chance to submit his brighter showpiece. He replaced the automatic spring with a bent copper strip, used sailcloth as a wind seal, gave every pane the same fastening, and widened the latch for wet gloves. The lamp became heavier and less brilliant. He chose that version anyway, surrendering the prize for greatest beam distance.

In the next storm, another pane cracked. The keeper took ordinary glass from the shelf, slid out the broken piece, and fitted the new one before the fifteen-minute sandglass emptied. When Gu Yan reached the tower three days later, the imported spring from his first lamp still lay rusted on the bench. Above it, the heavier lamp was already burning, maintained by the hands that depended on it.
storyParagraphsZh: 顾岩需要港口每年的灯具订单，才能让四名学徒熬过冬天。他造了一盏在评审桌上无人能及的暴风灯：进口弹簧自动调节灯芯，薄水晶把光投遍大厅，轻合金外壳又方便搬运，配方只有他知道。评委赞叹亮度，还没问灯塔里由谁维修，就把合同给了他。
第一场风暴打裂一块水晶，两夜后的盐雾又卡住弹簧。守塔人打开库房，只找到普通玻璃、铜片、旧帆布和适合粗螺丝的工具。顾岩住在三日外，进口弹簧要数周才能送到。灯灭了两个夜晚，进港船只只能依赖较远的旧灯标；临时修补后，它也只能发出暗光。顾岩却责怪守塔人保养粗糙。
第二年，港口改了规则：作品只能用塔内常备材料，守塔人还要戴着湿手套，在一刻钟内换掉任何外露零件。顾岩说这等于羞辱创造。其中确有一条守旧规定——外壳必须照搬旧灯的圆形，虽然货架也放得下别的形状——他便拿这条荒唐要求，否定了所有限制。
他准备退赛，学徒却把冬季工资簿放到桌上。失去订单，两户人家就少了收入，工作室炉火也只能停一半。顾岩重新去灯塔，在雨中看守塔人做事：湿手套抓不住细扣，风一大，打开的零件会滚向楼梯。真正的边界不是三种神奇材料，而是距离、盐雾、冻僵的手、现有工具和熄灯的代价。他成功质疑了圆壳规定，却接受库存和维修要求。
第一版易修的新灯在侧风里熄灭。顾岩损失一周，也错过提交那件耀眼展品的机会。他用弯铜片代替自动弹簧，以帆布封风，让所有玻璃共用一种固定件，又把门扣加宽，方便湿手套操作。新灯更重，也没那么亮。他仍选择这版，放弃了最远光程奖。
下一场风暴又打裂玻璃。守塔人从架上拿起普通玻璃，抽出碎片，在一刻钟沙漏漏完以前装好，湿手套始终没有脱下。三天后顾岩赶到塔里，第一盏灯的进口弹簧仍锈在工作台上；它的上方，那盏较重、光程也较短的新灯已经亮着。
explanationParagraphs: Design constraints are requirements and boundaries that define feasible solutions, including user needs, safety, materials, maintenance conditions, cost, and time. Real constraints expose trade-offs and can prompt more suitable designs. Constraints should still be examined: designers must distinguish fixed conditions from assumptions that have never been questioned.
explanationParagraphsZh: 设计约束是限定可行方案的要求与边界，例如使用者需要、安全、材料、维修条件、成本和时间。真实约束会迫使设计者面对取舍，并可能激发更适用的方案。约束本身也应接受检验：要区分不可改变的条件、可协商限制与从未被质疑的假设。

articles.title: The Wall Where Everyone Shouted
articles.summary: A painter gives every guild equal prominence to protect his funding, until the city's founding story can no longer begin.
articles.summaryZh: 画师为了保住各行会的资助，让每一处同样醒目，结果建城故事再也找不到开头。
storyParagraphs: The city council hired Baichuan to paint its founding across the assembly-hall wall, but each guild supplied part of his fee. The smiths demanded the largest furnace, the boatbuilders wanted every vessel in bright blue, and the weavers insisted that every cloth show its complete red pattern. Baichuan needed all three payments to keep his assistants employed. He promised equal prominence, making every figure the same height and every tool equally bright.

During the first public tour, the guide tried to begin with the lighting of the harbour's first lamp. The children looked instead at a golden hammer in the lower corner. When she pointed to the first ship, their eyes jumped to twelve strips of red cloth; when she described the market, a blue mast pulled them back across the wall. Every guild had received attention, yet the story could not travel from one event to the next.

Baichuan added labels and gilded arrows. The wall grew louder. Visitors read whichever plaque stood nearest and missed the figures between them. At the council rehearsal, three officials began speaking from three different points because each believed his guild's scene was the beginning. The chairman postponed the inauguration and warned Baichuan that further delay would forfeit the final payment.

That night, Baichuan extinguished the hall lamps and lit one small flame before the painted harbour lantern. His eye landed there, followed the angle of a sail toward the docks, and then reached the workshops. He spent the night lowering distant colour, simplifying repeated cloth patterns, changing intervals between groups, and turning several painted arms toward the first light. He erased no guild, but he gave up the promise that every part would call equally loudly.

At dawn, the head smith saw that his golden hammer had become smaller and threatened to withdraw his payment. Baichuan asked him to wait at the entrance for the first school group. The children found the harbour light, then the person raising it, followed the sails to the dock, and finally reached the forge where the hammer now completed the sequence. The smith still refused half his contribution; Baichuan paid his assistants from his own final fee.

The inauguration opened a full week late. As the guide finished the founding story without interruption, the head smith crossed the hall with the brass label that had once sat beside his hammer. He fixed it beneath the forge in the final section, then stepped back beside Baichuan at the doorway to see where his eye began in the quiet hall.
storyParagraphsZh: 城议会请白川把建城史画满议事厅长墙，报酬却由各行会分别承担。铁匠要求炉火最大，船工要每条船都用亮蓝色，织工坚持每匹布完整露出红花纹。白川需要三笔钱养活助手，颜料账也正压在桌角，只好承诺同等醒目：人物一律等高，工具件件发亮。每次有人要求加重一处，他便在另外两处也补上相同亮度。
第一次开放参观，讲解员想从港口第一盏灯被点燃说起，孩子们却盯着下角的金锤。她指向第一艘船，目光又跳到十二匹红布；刚讲市场，一根蓝桅杆又把所有人拉回墙的另一端。有人中途问建城究竟先发生了什么，讲解员只得从头再来。每个行会都得到了注目，建城的故事却无法从一件事走到下一件事。
白川加上说明牌和镀金箭头，墙面反而更吵。访客只读离自己最近的牌，漏掉中间人物；金色箭头又与金锤争抢目光。议会彩排时，三名官员甚至从三处同时开讲，因为人人都认为自家行会才是开头。主席敲桌暂停，推迟揭幕，并警告再晚下去就扣掉尾款。
那夜，白川熄灭厅灯，只在壁画中央的港灯前点一小盏火。他从入口反复走到墙前，发现视线先落在火光，再沿倾斜的船帆走向码头，最后抵达工坊。他整夜压低远处颜色，删减重复布纹，拉开人群间距，又让几条画中手臂朝向最初的灯。每改一处，他都退回门口重看。他没有抹掉任何行会，却放弃了“每处都同样响亮”的承诺。
天亮后，铁匠头领发现金锤变小，扬言撤回出资，还要求白川当场补回金色。白川没有拿起画笔，只请他在门口等第一队学生。孩子们先看见港灯，再看点灯人，顺着船帆找到码头，最后走到锻炉前，金锤在那里收住整条路线。铁匠仍扣下一半款项，白川只得用自己的尾款付助手工资，也推迟了画室租金。
揭幕晚了一周。讲解员第一次没有被墙面打断，孩子们也走到了故事结尾。铁匠抱着原先贴在金锤旁的铜牌穿过大厅，把它钉到最后一段的锻炉下面。随后他与白川一同退回门口，重新看自己的目光从哪里开始。
explanationParagraphs: Visual hierarchy organises the order in which elements attract attention and are understood. Scale, contrast, colour, position, spacing, direction, and detail work together to guide viewing. Hierarchy is not a ranking of moral worth, and social equality does not require identical visual emphasis. Without hierarchy, a complex composition may become unreadable.
explanationParagraphsZh: 视觉层级组织元素吸引注意和被理解的先后。尺度、对比、颜色、位置、间距、方向与细节共同引导观看。层级不等于价值排名；社会意义上的平等也不要求所有元素具有相同视觉强度。没有层级，复杂画面可能无法被清楚阅读。

articles.title: Between Two Hands
articles.summary: A painter keeps filling a farewell commission until a leak removes the only crowded place the client cannot stop looking at.
articles.summaryZh: 画家不断填满一幅送别图，漏雨却洗掉了委托人唯一无法移开目光的那一小块。
storyParagraphs: Shen Yao accepted a harbour farewell commission because its fee would cover the rent on her studio. The client wanted viewers to recognise the departure at once, so Shen painted trunks, tickets, ropes, porters, warehouses, and a ship beyond the two central figures. She described every fold in their coats. At each visit the client stood back and said, 'It still looks like an ordinary day at the quay.' Afraid of losing the payment, Shen filled another open patch.

She stretched the figures' hands toward each other, then packed the space around their fingers with a knotted rope, fluttering tickets, and the corner of a travelling case. The picture became busier and more expensive-looking. It also became harder to tell whether the figures were meeting, trading, or parting. With three days left, the client requested more relatives in the background and offered a bonus for finishing on time. Shen worked through the night.

Rain entered through the old roof before dawn. One leak struck the wet paint between the two hands. When Shen woke, the tickets, knot, and distant faces in that patch had bled into grey water down the wall. The hands remained on either side, no longer touching. She had neither time nor spare pigment to repaint everything, and the damaged commission could cost both the fee and the promised bonus.

Shen raised her brush to rebuild the lost details. The client arrived and stopped in the doorway. Her eyes went first to the bare interval, returned to the left hand, then crossed it again to the right. After a long silence she said that, on the actual day, the departing ship had moved before those hands met. Shen lowered the brush. The rain had not painted the farewell; it had removed what prevented the distance from taking shape.

The client still wanted the surrounding relatives restored. Shen refused to crowd the centre again and surrendered the completion bonus. She scraped away several nearby ropes, reduced a warehouse roof, and shifted the travelling case lower so the unpainted interval had a clear edge and proportion. The blank patch alone was not enough; every remaining form had to hold it in place. She used the last pigment to repair the two cuffs, not to fill the wall between them.

The final payment covered only part of the overdue rent, and the watermark remained faintly visible below the picture. At delivery, Shen added one thin wash near the damaged plaster, signed below the surviving stain, and packed away her unused brush. Between the two hands, she made no further mark.
storyParagraphsZh: 沈遥接下一幅码头送别图，因为报酬刚好够付画室租金。委托人希望别人一眼看出离别，她便画上箱子、票据、缆绳、搬运工、仓房和远船，还把两位主角的每道衣褶描清。委托人每次来看，都退后说：“仍像码头上普通的一天。”沈遥怕失去尾款，就继续填掉一处空白。画室越拥挤，她越相信再多一个标志就会更清楚。
她让两个人伸手相向，又在指尖周围塞进绳结、飘动的船票和提箱一角。画面更热闹，也更像一件昂贵成品，却越来越难判断两人在相遇、交易还是分开。来访者的目光总被行李截走，没有一次停在两个人身上。只剩三天时，委托人还要求背景多添亲属，并承诺准时交画就给奖金。沈遥整夜没有离开画室。
黎明前，旧屋顶漏雨，一滴水正落在两只手之间的湿颜料上。沈遥醒来时，那里的票据、绳结和远处人脸已经化成灰水，沿墙流下。两只手留在两侧，没有碰到，雨痕下方还积着一小摊混色颜料。她既没有时间，也没有颜料重画全部；这处损坏可能让尾款和奖金一起消失。
她举起笔，准备把细节补回去，已经调好与旧票据相同的灰黄。委托人进门后却停住了，目光先落在那段空处，再回到左手，又穿过空处去看右手。沉默许久，那人说，真正离船那天，船动得太早，两只手确实没能握住。沈遥把调好的颜色刮回盘边。雨没有替她画出告别，只是洗掉了阻碍那段距离成形的东西。
委托人仍希望恢复周围亲属。沈遥拒绝再次塞满中央，也因此放弃了准时奖金，双方还为少画的人物扣掉一部分尾款。她刮掉附近几根绳，压低一片仓顶，又把提箱移向下方，让空处拥有清楚轮廓和比例。单独一块白墙并不足够，留下的形体也得共同托住它。最后的颜料，她只用来修两边袖口。
尾款只够补交一部分房租，画下方还留着淡淡水痕。交付前，沈遥在受潮墙边添了一层薄色，又把名字签在残留水痕下面，收起那支没有用完的笔。两只手之间，她没有再落下一笔。
explanationParagraphs: Negative space is the area around, between, and within depicted forms. It has shape, proportion, rhythm, and visual weight, and it changes figure-ground relationships, balance, emphasis, and meaning. It is not simply blankness or minimalism; its effect comes from its specific relationship with forms and the whole composition.
explanationParagraphsZh: 负空间是形体周围、之间与内部的区域，也具有形状、比例、节奏和视觉重量。它会改变图底关系、平衡、重点与意义。负空间不只是空白或极简风格，也不会天然产生情感；它的作用来自与具体形体、尺度、位置和整体构图之间的关系。

articles.title: The Rain That Would Not Become Stone
articles.summary: A painter fights to preserve every transparent wash on stone, until wet blocks reveal what the new wall can do that paper cannot.
articles.summaryZh: 画家执意在石头上保住每层透明水色，湿石块却让她看见新墙能做到纸张做不到的事。
storyParagraphs: The city chose Shen Lan's best-known rainy watercolour for the station wall, and she accepted because the public commission could establish her beyond paper painting. She required the mason to reproduce every effect exactly: distant roofs must remain translucent, blue puddles must reveal the layer beneath, and the rain curtain must preserve the paper's white. The contract named her original as the approved image. Any visible departure could be rejected without payment.

The mason stained the stone. Grey turned muddy, blue sat heavily on the surface, and a thin unpainted patch looked unfinished rather than luminous. Shen asked for more water and less pigment. Wind faded the first wash; mineral bloom clouded the second; the third held colour but lost the transparent depth she wanted. They ground the same section away three times, consuming both the spare stone and half the schedule.

The station master demanded one final copy before the unveiling. The mason warned that another grinding would weaken the carved joints. Shen insisted that changing the image would betray the work people had selected. During their argument, rain crossed the test yard. Water ran along shallow grooves, deep cuts gathered shadow, rough stone held a broken wet shine, and polished stone reflected the pale sky. The mason placed one dry block and one wet block beside her palette.

Shen spent the night moving between the original paper and the two blocks. By dawn, the pale imitation had failed on the wet stone, and Shen admitted that the transfer itself had to change. In the morning she scraped off the last coloured wash. The station master stopped payment and gave her two days to restore the approved copy. Shen used those unpaid days to carve instead of repaint.

Shallow and deep cuts established the roofs; stone eaves channelled actual water through the image; rough areas broke the shine into rain, while polished hollows became puddles. In dry weather the wall remained mostly grey and seemed quieter than the watercolour. When rain arrived, flow, shadow, and reflection completed it. Shen had not discovered a rule forbidding pigment or mixed methods. She had stopped asking stone to behave as paper before asking what its weight, surface, and exposure could contribute.

Unveiling day came under a clear sky. Some officials complained that the famous blue puddles were missing. Shen left the framed original indoors, carried a bucket up the station steps, and poured water into the carved eaves. The dry wall darkened from the top, and the first reflected patch of sky appeared at her feet.
storyParagraphsZh: 城里选中沈岚最有名的一幅雨景水彩，要把它做在车站外墙。她看重这项公共委托，因为它能使自己的名声走出纸面，复制品还会被每天进站的人看见。她要求石匠逐项复制：远处屋顶的灰必须半透明，蓝水洼要露出底层，雨幕还得保留纸白。合同也把原画列作验收标准，任何明显偏离都可能被拒付。
石匠给石头染色，灰变得浑浊，蓝沉沉压在表面，薄薄不涂的地方也不像透光，只像漏了工。沈岚要求水更多、颜料更少。第一遍被风吹淡，第二遍被石碱蒙白，第三遍终于留色，却失去她想要的透明深浅。他们磨掉同一段三次，耗尽备用石，也花掉一半工期。
站长要求揭幕前再做最后一版。石匠提醒，继续磨会削弱刻缝，沈岚仍坚持：改动图像就是背离大家选中的作品。争论时，一阵雨穿过试工院。水顺浅沟流动，深凿处积起暗影，粗石留住碎水光，磨平的石面映回灰白天空。石匠把一块干石、一块湿石并排放到她的调色盘旁。
沈岚整夜在原画和两块石头之间来回，纸上的薄色在灯下仍轻，湿石却随着水迹不断改变。天亮时，苍白仿品仍贴不住湿石，沈岚终于承认：材料一换，作品本身也必须改变。天亮后，她刮掉最后一层彩色薄涂。站长暂停付款，只给两天恢复原样。沈岚用这两天无偿工期继续刻石，没有重画。
深浅刻痕安排屋顶远近，石檐把真正的水引进画面，粗面把亮光打碎成雨，磨亮的凹处则成为水洼。干燥时，墙大多只是灰色，比原水彩安静；雨来以后，水流、暗影和反光才把它补全。沈岚并非由此禁止颜料或混合材料，她只是先停止逼石头假装成纸，再去使用它的重量、表面与露天位置。
揭幕日偏偏晴朗，有官员抱怨那几块著名的蓝水洼不见了。沈岚把装框原画留在室内，提一桶水走上台阶，从刻出的屋檐缓缓倒下。干墙自上而下变深，第一小块天空的倒影出现在她脚边。
explanationParagraphs: Medium specificity refers to the distinctive possibilities and limits produced by a medium's material, process, conventions, and mode of viewing. Moving a work into another medium is not a matter of copying every prior effect; it requires asking how the new medium can carry, resist, or transform it. The idea need not reject mixed media, but it does require attention to material difference.
explanationParagraphsZh: 媒介特性指一种媒介的材料、过程、惯例与观看方式所提供的独特可能和限制。把作品转入另一媒介，不是逐项复制原有效果，而是判断新媒介能怎样承载、抵抗或改变它。这个概念并不排斥混合媒介，而要求创作者认真对待材料差异。
